windows.60: Over the past 60 days, visitors have noted issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, particularly regarding limited menu options and long wait times. Several reviews mentioned that the food quality did not meet expectations, with specific complaints about bland or poorly prepared items. Wait times for food orders were also a concern, including instances where the kitchen was backed up and unable to take orders promptly. While the overall rating remains above four, these service and menu-related problems should be addressed to improve the visitor experience.
windows.90: Visitor feedback over the last 90 days shows consistent concerns about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many reviews mention limited menu options, long wait times, and issues with food quality, including complaints about portion sizes and pricing. Several visitors noted that the kitchen was often backed up, leading to delays and restricted ordering options late in the day. While some found certain dishes acceptable, the overall sentiment points to dissatisfaction with the café’s value and service. There were fewer comments about the atmosphere or other aspects of the visit.
